concept.summary: An adult word-search book about how cars work and how people look after them: engines, maintenance, tools, vehicle systems, motorsport, automotive history and driving culture, each puzzle built from factual, generic automotive terms.
concept.subject: Automotive technology, maintenance and car culture
concept.reader_experience: Relaxed solving with vocabulary a car enthusiast recognizes; difficulty rises gently from warm-up grids to larger challenge grids.
concept.scope: Seven themes on vehicle technology, care and culture. No brand or model names.

positioning.primary_audience: Adult car enthusiasts (working assumption, not validated)
positioning.secondary_audience: Automotive students and hobby mechanics (candidate, not validated)
candidate_audiences: Adults who enjoy themed word searches
positioning.tone: Knowledgeable and friendly, with plain factual theme titles
positioning.use_case: Leisure solving at home or while travelling
positioning.main_benefit: Themed puzzles built from real automotive vocabulary rather than general car words.
positioning.differentiation: Hypothesis to test: themes organized around how vehicles work and are maintained, using technical terms, rather than a general mix of car-related words.

notes: Generic terms only. No brand, model, team or driver names.
Factual terminology. No slang that could read as offensive.

feasibility.label: Puzzle count
feasibility.detail: A project holds at most 20 puzzle definitions today. The plan may describe a larger book; producing it needs the cap reviewed first (docs/book-planning.md#generator-limits).

feasibility.label: Word banks
feasibility.detail: Each theme pool can become one word bank.

feasibility.label: Difficulty profiles
feasibility.detail: Each level can become one difficulty profile.

feasibility.label: Generator settings
feasibility.detail: Level grids, directions and word counts are within the generator's limits.

feasibility.label: Puzzle grids on the page
feasibility.detail: Each level's grid fits the live area at 9 pt or more before the title and word list are laid out (assuming the paperback-8.5x11 page geometry). The interior layout decides with the real word list.

feasibility.label: Solution grids
feasibility.detail: Each level's solution fits 2 a page at 7 pt or more before captions (assuming the paperback-8.5x11 page geometry).

feasibility.label: Words fit their grids
feasibility.detail: All 70 assigned words fit their level's grid in an enabled direction.

feasibility.label: Page count
feasibility.detail: About 94-96 logical pages from the plan. The exact count comes from the publication plan; the renderer never pads.

feasibility.label: Spine text
feasibility.detail: Likely: the estimate reaches the 80 pages spine text needs.

feasibility.label: Puzzle generation
feasibility.detail: Whether every grid places all its words is known only when production generates and verifies each puzzle. Placement is bounded and may fail for dense grids.

feasibility.label: Cover
feasibility.detail: Cover size and spine derive from the built interior's real page count and paper; they cannot be planned exactly.
